test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements in the light of the given passage is FALSE?

options.text: Future economic growth will be reliant on middle class and middle class's development will be dependent on economic growth.
China's middle class is currently smaller than India's middle class.
India's middle class will be significantly larger and younger than other countries, like China.
A huge population is expected to escape poverty and reach the middle class.

solution:
The solution is **China's middle class is currently smaller than India's middle class.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** **China's middle class is currently smaller than India's middle class is following statements in the light of the given passage is FALSE.
 
• Therefore **option 2 **is the correct option.
